info.title: SUAS API
info.description: Machine-readable contract for the implemented `/api/v0` surface. Authentication is an opaque Bearer credential; this API never reads cookies. Browser callers on origins listed in `SUAS_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` receive CORS headers and preflight answers (D-038, released in spec 0.7.0); other browser-originated unsafe requests receive `403 FORBIDDEN`. Paths document what the runtime registers today; draft APIS.md Plane A paths that are not yet implemented are intentionally absent. Every error uses the API.md §6 envelope. A malformed id, body or URL is 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with a short message (schema failures add error.details.issues); an oversized body is 413 and oversized headers are 431, both with code VALIDATION_FAILED.

post.summary: Execute a released service-request command
post.description: SUBMIT, CANCEL and CONFIRM may be run only by the requester; every other command only by the person who accepted this request (403 for the requester; 404 for anyone else, including another helper on the same case). SUBMIT needs a meeting_place on the request for FOOD, TRANSPORTATION and SHELTER (422 UNPROCESSABLE). Only SUBMIT needs a Veteran with a VERIFIED VA Veteran Confirmation (403 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED otherwise); the other commands do not. A command whose transition needs a reason (for example CANCEL) sent without one is 400 VALIDATION_FAILED. EXPIRE is run only by the System (DISPATCH.md §4, §14.6): 403 for any caller. The accepter's command is re-checked against the current holder under the request row lock (403 if someone else holds it now). An unknown `to` or `expected_status` value is 400 VALIDATION_FAILED. FULFILL emits SERVICE_FULFILLED and ACCEPT emits SERVICE_ACCEPTED (DISPATCH.md §4). RELEASE (DISPATCH.md §14.7; R8.5, D-059, D-061, released in 0.9.0) is the accepter's command: it needs a reason (400 VALIDATION_FAILED without one) and moves an ACCEPTED request back to SUBMITTED. The holder and accept time are cleared, the chat thread is closed, the request returns to the open list, and the requester gets an in-app notice. The same helper may accept it again; the next accept opens a new chat thread.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The command in lowercase, as API.md §8 and §18 name it (for example `release`, `start-matching`). Matching is case-insensitive and `-` equals `_`; the UPPERCASE enum value (`RELEASE`) is kept as an alias for existing clients. Both spellings share one idempotency scope.

Other requests of the same Veteran stay open to other people. A first accept on an OPEN case also moves the case to ASSIGNED. First accept wins: a second person gets 409 ALREADY_CLAIMED. post.summary: Confirm Veteran status with VA (one attempt; suas-specs #72 R9.1)
post.description: Sends the VA_CONFIRMATION_V1_REQUIRED_ONLY projection to VA Veteran Confirmation once and returns only the normalized result. SUAS never stores, logs or audits the projection values; the attempt row keeps the result, the notice version, a keyed request fingerprint and, when VA answered, a keyed identity hash (HMAC under SUAS_FINGERPRINT_KEY, with its key id). Any signed-in person may call it. The body must carry noticeVersion va-notice-v1, the pre-call notice the person saw (400 VA_NOTICE_VERSION_REQUIRED otherwise). The typed first and last name must match the account display name ("First Last" or "First L.", ignoring case, accents and punctuation); otherwise 409 VA_NAME_MISMATCH with no VA call and no attempt counted. A VA VERIFIED standing is returned with no VA call; a REVOKED standing is refused (403). At most 5 VA-answered attempts (VERIFIED, NOT_CONFIRMED, or an identity conflict) per person in the last 24 hours (429 VERIFICATION_ATTEMPT_LIMIT, with Retry-After); UNAVAILABLE results (outages and VA 400s) never count. A backstop cap of 20 VA calls per person in the last 24 hours counts the same rows (same 429). The same Idempotency-Key within 24 hours replays an answer VA gave; after an UNAVAILABLE result, or after a fingerprint key rotation, it is a new attempt. No database lock is held during the VA call; a second attempt while one is in flight gets 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. NOT_CONFIRMED is not a finding that the person never served. UNAVAILABLE means VA did not answer: failure_class REQUEST_INVALID (VA refused the request, e.g. HTTP 400) means the person may correct the details and retry; other classes mean try again later. Neither UNAVAILABLE nor NOT_CONFIRMED blocks a request: the person may self-attest instead.

200.description: The settled result of this attempt, an identical replay, or the existing VERIFIED standing

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: a field does not match the VA pattern, an unknown field was sent, or the Idempotency-Key header is missing; the message names fields only, never values. VA_NOTICE_VERSION_REQUIRED: noticeVersion is missing or not va-notice-v1.

403.description: VERIFICATION_REVOKED: SUAS revoked this person's confirmation; no new attempt is taken

409.description: VA_NAME_MISMATCH: the typed name does not match the account display name (no VA call, not counted). VA_IDENTITY_ALREADY_VERIFIED: these details cannot be used to verify this account (counted; the message never names another account). IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the key was used with a different body, or another attempt is still in flight.

429.description: VERIFICATION_ATTEMPT_LIMIT: 5 VA-answered attempts (VERIFIED, NOT_CONFIRMED, an attempt in flight or an identity conflict) in the last 24 hours, or the backstop cap of 20 VA calls, which counts the same rows; outages and VA 400s (UNAVAILABLE) count toward neither. Retry-After gives the seconds until the person is under the 5 tries again.

503.description: ID_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE: VA confirmation is not offered in this environment (SUAS_VA_CONFIRMATION_MODE=disabled). Not an outage; self-attestation stays available.

post.summary: Self-attest Veteran status (D-016 fallback; suas-specs #72 R9.1)
post.description: Writes a SELF_ATTESTATION VERIFIED row with source SUAS, which opens the request gate. No VA call, no attempt limit, and available whatever the VA confirmation mode. A VERIFIED standing of any method is returned with no new row; a REVOKED standing is refused (403). The body is empty or {}.

200.description: The standing after self-attesting, or the existing VERIFIED standing

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: a field was sent, or the Idempotency-Key header is missing

403.description: VERIFICATION_REVOKED: SUAS revoked this person's confirmation

post.summary: Edit a pending Resource Draft
post.description: SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only. Changes any subset of the draft fields; null clears an optional field. A draft that is already published or discarded returns 409 ILLEGAL_TRANSITION.

post.summary: Extract Resource Drafts from pasted source text
post.description: SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only. Sends the pasted text to the model and stores zero or more drafts with the source link. Output that fails validation creates no draft and returns 502 CATALOG_EXTRACTION_FAILED. Returns 503 CATALOG_BUILDER_UNAVAILABLE when no model is configured. Nothing here creates a Resource or reaches Veterans. Requires Idempotency-Key: a retry with the same key returns the drafts the first request created (re-read, so their current state) with replayed true, and creates no second set or model call (API.md §7).

get.summary: List Resource Drafts
get.description: SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only. Newest first, bounded by limit and cursor. `builder.available` is false, with a plain message, when the catalog builder cannot run; Resources can still be created without it.

post.summary: Discard a pending Resource Draft
post.description: SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only. Marks the draft REJECTED and keeps it on record; no Resource is created. Audited.

post.summary: Publish a pending Resource Draft
post.description: SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only. Creates the Resource, records the verification against the draft's source link, and activates it, in one transaction. The publish is the verification act; the model never sets last_verified_at. Audited.

get.summary: Whether the licence review path is offered, and the newest review (suas-specs R10.1, proposal)
get.description: Any signed-in person. The path is offered only after VA answered NOT_CONFIRMED (never after UNAVAILABLE, so never after a VA 400), beside self-attestation, never instead of it.

post.summary: Send licence photos and a selfie for review (suas-specs R10.1, proposal)
post.description: The server checks, in order: signed in (before the body is read), the reader is open (503), L1.4 eligibility (403), notice_version (400), no open review (409), the limit (429), then the image rules (400). It stores the three re-encoded images, records a READING review bound to the person's newest NOT_CONFIRMED VA attempt and queues the read. No Idempotency-Key: a second send while one is open gets 409 LICENCE_REVIEW_OPEN. Only reader-answered submissions count toward the limit.

202.description: Stored and queued: the review in its current state (READING, or already read in LOCAL and TEST)

400.description: LICENCE_NOTICE_VERSION_REQUIRED: notice_version is missing or not licence-notice-v1. VALIDATION_FAILED: an image is not a JPEG, is over 2000 px on the long side or 1,000,000 bytes, or a field is missing or unknown; the message names the fields only.

413.description: The whole body is over 4,500,000 bytes.

429.description: LICENCE_SUBMISSION_LIMIT: 3 reader-answered submissions in the last 24 hours (or the absolute cap of 10); Retry-After says when. Separate from the VA VERIFICATION_ATTEMPT_LIMIT.

503.description: ID_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE: the licence reader is disabled here or its circuit breaker is open.

403.description: LICENCE_REVIEW_NOT_OFFERED: the newest VA-answered attempt is not NOT_CONFIRMED with PERSON_NOT_FOUND, NOT_TITLE_38 or MORE_RESEARCH_REQUIRED, the person is at the VA try limit, revoked, or already confirmed.

409.description: LICENCE_REVIEW_OPEN: a review is already open.

post.summary: Dispute an ALREADY_USED decline with new photos (suas-specs R10.1 L7.3, proposal)
post.description: Opens a new review marked as a dispute of this one, bound to the same VA attempt; the earlier images were deleted at the decision. It skips the L1.4 offer but follows the notice, limits and read. The queue routes it away from the admins who approved or confirmed the conflicting review.

202.description: Stored and queued: the review in its current state (READING, or already read in LOCAL and TEST)

400.description: LICENCE_NOTICE_VERSION_REQUIRED: notice_version is missing or not licence-notice-v1. VALIDATION_FAILED: an image is not a JPEG, is over 2000 px on the long side or 1,000,000 bytes, or a field is missing or unknown; the message names the fields only.

413.description: The whole body is over 4,500,000 bytes.

429.description: LICENCE_SUBMISSION_LIMIT: 3 reader-answered submissions in the last 24 hours (or the absolute cap of 10); Retry-After says when. Separate from the VA VERIFICATION_ATTEMPT_LIMIT.

503.description: ID_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE: the licence reader is disabled here or its circuit breaker is open.

403.description: VERIFICATION_REVOKED: the person's standing is REVOKED.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no such review of this person.

409.description: LICENCE_REVIEW_NOT_DISPUTABLE: the review is not an ALREADY_USED decline. LICENCE_REVIEW_OPEN: a review is already open.

403.description: FORBIDDEN or MFA_REQUIRED.

get.summary: One licence review's page (suas-specs R10.1, proposal)

403.description: 401 and 403 (FORBIDDEN, MFA_REQUIRED) as on every admin route. SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: the review is the admin's own. REVIEWER_RECUSED: the admin recused, or (a dispute) approved or confirmed the conflicting review.

403.description: 401 and 403 (FORBIDDEN, MFA_REQUIRED) as on every admin route. SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: the review is the admin's own. REVIEWER_RECUSED: the admin recused, or (a dispute) approved or confirmed the conflicting review.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no such review, or its images were deleted (decided) or are gone from storage.

post.summary: First approval of a licence review (suas-specs R10.1 L5.4, proposal)
post.description: AWAITING_REVIEW to AWAITING_CONFIRMATION, recording the admin as approved_by. No VERIFIED row yet: a second, different admin must confirm. Requires the SUAS Admin role and MFA elevation; audited; Idempotency-Key required.

200.description: The review page, read fresh (also on a replay)

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: the body is not as documented, or the Idempotency-Key header is missing.

403.description: 401 and 403 (FORBIDDEN, MFA_REQUIRED) as on every admin route. SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: the review is the admin's own. REVIEWER_RECUSED: the admin recused, or (a dispute) approved or confirmed the conflicting review.

409.description: LICENCE_REVIEW_DECIDED: already decided. LICENCE_REVIEW_NOT_READY: not AWAITING_REVIEW. LICENCE_FINGERPRINT_MISSING: the number or state was not read. LICENCE_ALREADY_USED: the licence is on an APPROVED review in the tenant. LICENCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: identity match is not YES. All three can still be declined. IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the key was used for another request.

post.summary: Second admin's confirmation (suas-specs R10.1 L5.5, proposal)
post.description: AWAITING_CONFIRMATION to APPROVED by an admin other than approved_by: writes a MANUAL_REVIEW VERIFIED row (source SUAS) that opens the request gate, and deletes the images and the reading. Requires the SUAS Admin role and MFA elevation; audited; Idempotency-Key required.

200.description: The review page, read fresh (also on a replay)

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: the body is not as documented, or the Idempotency-Key header is missing.

403.description: 401 and 403 (FORBIDDEN, MFA_REQUIRED) as on every admin route. SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: the review is the admin's own. REVIEWER_RECUSED: the admin recused, or (a dispute) approved or confirmed the conflicting review. SECOND_REVIEWER_REQUIRED: the admin who approved cannot confirm.

409.description: LICENCE_REVIEW_DECIDED: already decided. LICENCE_REVIEW_NOT_READY: not AWAITING_CONFIRMATION. LICENCE_FINGERPRINT_MISSING: the number or state was not read. LICENCE_ALREADY_USED: the licence is on an APPROVED review in the tenant. LICENCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: identity match is not YES. All three can still be declined. IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the key was used for another request.

post.summary: Decline a licence review (suas-specs R10.1 L5.7, proposal)
post.description: From AWAITING_REVIEW or AWAITING_CONFIRMATION, by one admin. Deletes the images and the reading and clears the fingerprint. Requires the SUAS Admin role and MFA elevation; audited; Idempotency-Key required.

200.description: The review page, read fresh (also on a replay)

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: the body is not as documented, or the Idempotency-Key header is missing.

403.description: 401 and 403 (FORBIDDEN, MFA_REQUIRED) as on every admin route. SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: the review is the admin's own. REVIEWER_RECUSED: the admin recused, or (a dispute) approved or confirmed the conflicting review.

409.description: LICENCE_REVIEW_DECIDED: already decided. LICENCE_REVIEW_NOT_READY: still READING. IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the key was used for another request.

post.summary: Recuse from a licence review (suas-specs R10.1 L5.6, proposal)
post.description: Hides the review from this admin and refuses their commands on it. Repeating it changes nothing. Requires the SUAS Admin role and MFA elevation; audited; Idempotency-Key required.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: the body is not as documented, or the Idempotency-Key header is missing.

403.description: 401 and 403 (FORBIDDEN, MFA_REQUIRED) as on every admin route. SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: the review is the admin's own. REVIEWER_RECUSED: the admin recused, or (a dispute) approved or confirmed the conflicting review.

409.description: No state conflict applies. IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the key was used for another request.

post.summary: Revoke a licence approval (suas-specs R10.1 L7.1, proposal)
post.description: APPROVED to REVOKED, freeing the fingerprint. FRAUD writes a REVOKED row, which outranks every method, blocks self-attestation and releases the VA identity. REVIEW_ERROR writes a newer MANUAL_REVIEW NOT_CONFIRMED row, so the approval stops opening the gate without barring the person. Requires the SUAS Admin role and MFA elevation; audited; Idempotency-Key required.

200.description: The review page, read fresh (also on a replay)

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED: the body is not as documented, or the Idempotency-Key header is missing.

403.description: 401 and 403 (FORBIDDEN, MFA_REQUIRED) as on every admin route. SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: the review is the admin's own. REVIEWER_RECUSED: the admin recused, or (a dispute) approved or confirmed the conflicting review.

409.description: LICENCE_REVIEW_DECIDED: already revoked. LICENCE_REVIEW_NOT_READY: not APPROVED. IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the key was used for another request.

get.summary: List consent template versions
get.description: SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only. Every version of every template key, newest version first (CONSENT.md §6; ADMIN.md §2). R9.3 (contributor proposal, specs #72, not released).

post.summary: Create the next DRAFT version of a consent template
post.description: SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only. The server numbers the version (1 for a new key). Audited (CONSENT_TEMPLATE_VERSION_CREATED, key and version only). A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the version it made (200, replayed true); a concurrent create of the same key is 409 STALE_STATE. R9.3 (contributor proposal, specs #72, not released).

200.description: Replay of a version already created with this Idempotency-Key

post.summary: Publish a DRAFT consent template version
post.description: SUAS administrator (MFA-elevated session) only; one admin publishes (R9.3 owner answer). The key's earlier PUBLISHED version becomes SUPERSEDED in the same transaction, so new grants must cite the new version. Audited (CONSENT_TEMPLATE_PUBLISHED). A version that is not a DRAFT is 409 ILLEGAL_TRANSITION. R9.3 (contributor proposal, specs #72, not released).

get.summary: Read the current published version of a consent template
get.description: Any signed-in person. `purpose` is the template key, for example `red-alert-trusted-contact`; the answer is the version a new grant must cite. 404 when none is published. R9.3 (contributor proposal, specs #72, not released).

get.summary: List invites waiting for the signed-in person
get.description: Invites still INVITED to the caller's enrolled email, with the inviting Veteran's display name and the relationship label only; invites do not expire. Accept with POST /trusted-contacts/{id}/commands/accept. R9.4 (contributor proposal, specs #72, not released).

bearerAuth.description: Opaque session credential from challenge verify

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key that makes a retried command safe (API.md §7). Reusing it with a different request is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

PageCursor.name: cursor
PageCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor taken from a prior response's next_cursor (API.md §5). Without it the first page is returned.

details.description: Optional machine-readable detail. A 400 VALIDATION_FAILED from schema validation carries issues: [{ path, code, message }].

contacts.description: Up to three contact methods, in order. The first is mirrored in contact_method.

verified_at.description: The stored last_verified_at under a client-facing name; the publish date until a re-verify command exists.

ResourceDraft.description: A Resource Draft. It has no verification fields and is never shown to Veterans.

contacts.description: Up to three contact methods, in order (RESOURCES.md §12.2; R8.8, D-059, released in 0.9.0). 911, 988 and 838255 are refused, also with separators or a leading +1 or 1. A URL contact must be an http or https address and an EMAIL contact one plain address; anything else is refused with 400.

replayed.description: True when an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key created these drafts.

source_link.description: http or https URL of the pasted source; kept on every draft and used as the verification source on publish.

contacts.description: Up to three contact methods, in order (RESOURCES.md §12.2; R8.8, D-059, released in 0.9.0). 911, 988 and 838255 are refused, also with separators or a leading +1 or 1. A URL contact must be an http or https address and an EMAIL contact one plain address; anything else is refused with 400.

tenant_id.description: Legacy filter; people do not choose an organization.

IdVerification.description: The person's Veteran confirmation standing (suas-specs #72 R9.1): REVOKED when SUAS revoked it; else a VERIFIED row of VA_VETERAN_STATUS, MANUAL_REVIEW or SELF_ATTESTATION (in that order), which opens the request gate; else the newest settled VA attempt; else NOT_STARTED with method VA_VETERAN_STATUS.

not_confirmed_reason.description: VA's reason. ERROR comes with UNAVAILABLE; the others with NOT_CONFIRMED. Null otherwise.

failure_class.description: Why VA did not answer (D035 §11), with UNAVAILABLE; null when VA answered. REQUEST_INVALID means the person may correct the details and retry.

VaConfirmationRequest.description: The VA_CONFIRMATION_V1_REQUIRED_ONLY projection: the eight required VA fields, with country fixed to USA. No SSN. Plus noticeVersion, the pre-call notice the person saw. Unknown fields are refused. Patterns are VA's; each field is at most 256 characters.

birthDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a real date before today

noticeVersion.description: The pre-call notice version (VA_NOTICE_V1). It is stored on the attempt, not sent to VA.

not_confirmed_reason.description: VA's reason. ERROR comes with UNAVAILABLE; the others with NOT_CONFIRMED. Null otherwise.

failure_class.description: Why VA did not answer (D035 §11), with UNAVAILABLE; null when VA answered. REQUEST_INVALID means the person may correct the details and retry.

OpenCaseSummary.description: The current case of a Veteran: not RESOLVED or CLOSED. A Veteran whose case is resolved has none until they ask for help again, which opens a new case.

ActiveQrf.description: The caller's newest open Service Request, of any category (FOOD, TRANSPORTATION, SHELTER or PEER_SUPPORT).

is_admin.description: True when the person holds the SUAS System Administrator grant.

display_name.description: Trimmed, 1 to 40 characters. Guidance for the form: "First name and last initial, like Marcus T."

started_at.description: Server clock. The Check-In can be resumed for 24 hours from this time (CHECKINS.md §4.2, §4.4).

answered_question_ids.description: Questions that already have a saved answer, so a resumed Check-In can skip them.

ResolveCaseRequest.description: The author, the accepter and the requester confirmation are derived on the server from the session (the person resolving must hold a request of the case); they are not accepted from the body.

to.description: RETURN_FROM_ESCALATION only: the target status (TRIAGED or MATCHING).

ServiceRequestCommandRequest.description: SUBMIT, CANCEL and CONFIRM belong to the requester; every other command belongs to the person who accepted (403 otherwise).

details.description: Same bounded fields as the plain form. Unknown keys are refused (400).

destination.description: Where a ride is going. TRANSPORTATION only (422 UNPROCESSABLE for any other category). Optional. Shown only to the requester and the user recorded as having accepted, never in lists, logs or events.

meeting_place.description: Where to meet. Required to submit FOOD, TRANSPORTATION and SHELTER (422 UNPROCESSABLE); optional for PEER_SUPPORT. Never shown in lists.

destination.description: Where a ride is going. TRANSPORTATION only (422 UNPROCESSABLE for any other category). Optional. Shown only to the requester and the user recorded as having accepted, never in lists, logs or events.

case_id.description: ownership=mine and requested only. The open list never carries it, so helpers cannot link one Veteran's requests (DISPATCH.md §13.3, PRIVACY.md §4).

summary.description: The requester one-line summary. Timing and meeting place are never listed.

county.description: ownership=open and mine only: the requester county.

counterpart_display_name.description: ownership=mine only: the requester display name.

closed_at.description: ownership=requested only: set once the request reached a terminal status.

counts.description: DISPATCH.md §14.2 (v0.9.0, R7.3, R7.4, D-057). ownership=mine only: summary counts for the caller as a helper, over the same requests as the mine list (all pages, not just this one). Never returned for another user or aggregated across users.

helping_now.description: Requests the caller accepted that are not in a terminal status (CLOSED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, UNFULFILLABLE). Includes CONFIRMED, which waits for the helper's CLOSE, and ESCALATED.

closed_last_30_days.description: Requests the caller accepted that reached CLOSED in the last 30 days (rolling 30 x 24 hours on the server clock, by terminal time, inclusive). CANCELLED is not counted as closed.

destination.description: Where a ride is going. TRANSPORTATION only (422 UNPROCESSABLE for any other category). Optional. Shown only to the requester and the user recorded as having accepted, never in lists, logs or events.

accepted_at.description: DISPATCH.md §14.1 (v0.9.0, R7.2). When the request was accepted (the chat thread's creation time). null when no accept time is recorded: before accept, or legacy accepted requests. null does not mean not accepted. Not consent evidence (D-051). Shown only to the requester and the user recorded as having accepted, like meeting_place.

counterpart_display_name.description: For the requester: the display name of the person who accepted (null until accepted or if unnamed). For the accepter: the requester display name.

viewer_role.description: The caller side of this request.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor for older requests (newest first); null on the last page.

InviteTrustedContactRequest.description: At least one of invite_email and invite_phone is required.

contacts.description: Up to three contact methods, in order. The first is mirrored in contact_method.

verified_at.description: The stored last_verified_at under a client-facing name; the publish date until a re-verify command exists.

outcome.description: FALLBACK_FORM: the assistant did not answer; nothing new was stored, show the plain request form (request_form).

destination.description: Where a ride is going. TRANSPORTATION only (422 UNPROCESSABLE for any other category). Optional. Shown only to the requester and the user recorded as having accepted, never in lists, logs or events.

total.description: RESOURCES.md §12.1 (R7.1, D-057, released in 0.9.0). Resources matching the category and county filters across all pages, under the same tenant and visibility filters as the listed items.

chat_thread_id.description: DISPATCH.md §14.10 (R8.11, D-061, released in 0.9.0). Pass as `thread` to read this thread's messages. Always present in responses; optional in the contract so clients written before it still type-check.

last_message_body.description: Truncated to 140 characters; null when no message was sent yet.

accepted_at.description: DISPATCH.md §14.1 (R7.2, D-057, released in 0.9.0). When the request was accepted (the thread's creation time; a thread exists only after accept). Always present in responses; optional in the contract so clients written before it still type-check. Not consent evidence (D-051).

closed.description: The request is in a terminal status.

released_at.description: DISPATCH.md §14.7, §14.10 (R8.5, R8.11, D-061, released in 0.9.0). When a release ended this thread; null while it is live. A released thread is read-only and only its requester sees it. Always present in responses; optional in the contract so clients written before it still type-check.

role.description: The caller side of the thread.

last_message_from_me.description: True when the latest message was sent by the caller; null when there are no messages.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor for older threads; null on the last page.

BuildInfo.description: Build provenance (app commit/version, spec version, manifest, environment, schema version). No secrets.

meeting_place.description: null clears the meeting place; refused (422) for FOOD, TRANSPORTATION and SHELTER.

destination.description: Where a ride is going. TRANSPORTATION only (422 UNPROCESSABLE for any other category). Optional. Shown only to the requester and the user recorded as having accepted, never in lists, logs or events.

expected_status.description: Optional stale-state check; 409 STALE_STATE when the request is in another status. An unknown status is 400.

ServiceRequestEditRequest.description: Fields to change. Absent keys stay as they are. At least one field other than expected_status is required (400).

LicenceReviewStatus.description: suas-specs R10.1 (proposal). Open states are READING, AWAITING_REVIEW and AWAITING_CONFIRMATION; a person has at most one open review.

LicenceFailureClass.description: Why a review settled UNREADABLE. The reader was down (try later, not counted): CONFIGURATION_INVALID, AUTHENTICATION_REJECTED, REQUEST_INVALID, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, PROVIDER_RESPONSE_INVALID, TIMEOUT, NETWORK_ERROR. Send again (not counted): PHOTOS_GONE, PHOTOS_EXPIRED. NOT_SYNTHETIC (STAGING: no synthetic marker, nothing was sent; not counted). NOT_A_LICENCE (the reader answered; counted).

LicenceReviewView.description: A licence review as the Veteran sees it: states, codes and times only, never a licence field.

disputable.description: True for an ALREADY_USED decline while the licence path is open and the person is not revoked (L7.3).

offered.description: False when the reader is disabled or its breaker is open, the newest VA-answered attempt is not NOT_CONFIRMED (PERSON_NOT_FOUND, NOT_TITLE_38, MORE_RESEARCH_REQUIRED), the person is at the VA try limit, the standing is REVOKED, or the request gate is already open. An open review does not change it.

review.description: The person's newest review, or null.

data_base64.description: A JPEG of at most 2000 px on the long side and 1,000,000 bytes, base64. The server re-encodes it, dropping EXIF, XMP, ICC and comments.

LicenceSubmission.description: Front and back of the licence and one live selfie (camera only). The selfie is never sent to the reader.

LicenceIdentityMatch.description: Whether the licence's first name, last name and birth date match the details given to VA (same canonical form and key). Never the values.

agreed.description: False marks a field to check by eye.

LicenceReading.description: The reader's fields without the licence number or birth date (§2.1). The consistency checks do not show the card is genuine.

LicenceConflictingReview.description: The approved review already holding this licence: its record only; its images are gone.

AdminLicenceReview.description: The review page (L5.2, L5.3). The UI shows the three images first and reveals the rest only after the reviewer answers that the Veteran designation is visible. No subject name, user id, licence number or birth date.

images.description: Whether each image is still stored; all false once decided.

fingerprint_in_use.description: Whether this licence is on an APPROVED review in the tenant; null when the number or state was not read.

viewer.description: What this admin may try given the state; the server still enforces every rule.

LicenceApproval.description: The designation question and the by-eye checklist (L5.2, L5.3); every answer must be true. A 'no' means the admin declines instead.

selfie_matches.description: The selfie and the licence portrait show the same person.

security_features.description: Visible security features look present, without signs of editing.

whole_card.description: The photo shows a whole physical card, not a screen or printout.

version_key.description: <template_key>@<version>; what a grant cites as consent_template_version.
